**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or "best terms" obligation burdening AbbVie:

- Targeted searches for MFN phrasings (*most favored/favoured*, *no less favorable*, *as favorable as*, *best price*, *terms offered to any Third Party*, *match*) returned no hits.
- Article 5 (Grant of Rights) contains only the licence grants, exclusivity obligations on **Harpoon** (§5.8), and in-licence mechanics. §5.9.3's "Proposed Future In-Licensed Rights" is an elective opt-in — we choose whether to take a sublicence and only then accept its terms; it is not an obligation to extend Harpoon any better terms given to third parties.
- Article 6 payments and the §6.5.3 royalty reductions operate in our favour, and §4.3 gives AbbVie the sole right to set all terms of sale including pricing and discounts.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so nothing to redline.
